metadata.title: Your blood vessels are like a balloon
metadata.description: Your blood vessels are like a balloon—don’t let the pressure build up! Manage stress, eat healthy, stay active, and limit alcohol to keep your body in balance. Take care of your balloon, take care of your health! 💪 #hypertensionawareness  #healthyliving  #bloodpressurecontrol #StayActive #EatHealthy #selfcare  #stressmanagement  #hearthealth #psa
